## Review checklist

- [ ] I compared documentation with actual implementation.
- [ ] Status, changelog, testing and handover describe the same verified state.
- [ ] Relevant tests cover behavior changes and security boundaries.
- [ ] No unapproved scope expansion, secrets or overwritten local work.
- [ ] Relevant commits and available PR links are recorded in the handover.
